name: Paperwork
description: Reads whatever admin lands in your inbox or letterbox, identifies the document type and the action it demands, and logs both into a Notion database built for the purpose. Requires a Notion setup, and is aimed at people whose problem is forgetting deadlines rather than understanding the paperwork.

official.title: Paperwork by Liam
official.description: Takes every boring document someone receives, works out what it is and what needs doing, then tracks it in a Notion Paperwork database so nothing...
